the traditional Indian art form of Godna:
# Godna, an ancient and traditional form of tattooing, has been found on 10,000-year-old rock paintings and sculptures from the Indus Valley Civilization, signifying its deep historical roots in India.
# Primarily practiced by tribal communities like the Gond and Baiga, Godna is more than just an art form. It serves as a symbol of cultural identity, spiritual protection, and beauty.
